sql: WITH hist AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year yr,t.calendar_month_number month,SUM(s.amount_sold) sales_amount FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries cn ON cn.country_id=c.country_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id JOIN promotions pm ON pm.promo_id=s.promo_id WHERE cn.country_name='France' AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND pm.promo_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019,2020,2021) GROUP BY s.prod_id,t.calendar_year,t.calendar_month_number),p AS (SELECT a.prod_id,a.month,a.sales_amount s19,b.sales_amount s20,c.sales_amount s21,b.sales_amount*b.sales_amount/a.sales_amount v FROM hist a JOIN hist b ON a.prod_id=b.prod_id AND a.month=b.month AND a.yr=2019 AND b.yr=2020 LEFT JOIN hist c ON c.prod_id=a.prod_id AND c.month=a.month AND c.yr=2021 WHERE a.sales_amount>0) SELECT month,COUNT(*) history_products,SUM(s21 IS NOT NULL) roster_2021,ROUND(AVG(v),2) independent,ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s21 IS NOT NULL THEN v END),2) roster_month_round,ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s21 IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(v,2) END),2) roster_product_and_month_round FROM p GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
